products.name: Bolt Forge
products.tagline: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage
products.description: Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs on open-source models. Every Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage with no daily caps. Scores 91% of Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark.

products.name: Mantra Timer
products.tagline: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
products.description: Mantra Meditation Timer rejects the bloated tracking of modern wellness apps. Built for self-directed practitioners, this elegant iOS app offers a distraction-free experience with zero data collection. Enjoy core Meditation timers, calming chimes, and mental or physical check-ins completely free. For established pro mantra practitioners, a small one-off payment unlocks advanced stats and deeper customisation. No subscription fatigue, just a beautifully simple tool for profound daily practice.

products.name: Lumiko
products.tagline: Screen recordings that edit themselves with Auto Zoom-Pan
products.description: Lumiko records your screen and edits the footage while you work. It tracks your cursor and clicks, then builds smooth zoom and pan moves over them automatically, no keyframes. Trim, split, and reorder clips on a timeline right in the browser. Smart Blur hides API keys and passwords in one drag. Add a webcam bubble, custom backgrounds, click effects. Exports up to 4K. Runs locally, no account, no upload queue. Free to start.

products.name: Steam Frame
products.tagline: Your Steam library, now on a wearable PC
products.description: Steam Frame is a wireless SteamOS headset that streams your whole library from a PC, Deck, or Machine, and runs standalone titles too. Dual radios plus an included adapter keep streaming stable. The controllers work as VR wands and a full gamepad.

products.name: Lull
products.tagline: Tell it what is on your mind. It writes the meditation.
products.description: Lull doesn't play recordings. Talk for a minute about what's actually going on and it writes a meditation for that moment, read in one of 11 voices. Oura recovery shapes the tone. Apple Watch records your heart rate and shows the real settle after, or nothing.

products.name: Squirrel
products.tagline: An app blocker that pays you back
products.description: Squirrel puts a price on the apps you open too much. Tap Instagram and you get a hard block, not a screen you can wave away. Want to check a DM? That's fine, but you have to open Squirrel, pick how long, and set aside a few dollars for yourself first. No money moves through the app. No card or bank account to connect. When you're ready, invest it in your own brokerage and tell Squirrel what you bought. It tracks your holdings with live prices.

products.name: Doneit 3.2
products.tagline: Reimagined Doneit Assist, support for Siri AI, and more
products.description: You can now attach photos when planning tasks with Doneit Assist to turn a handwritten list, whiteboard or a document into tasks, include additional details to make tasks more accurate, as well as let it suggest reminders and attributes for tasks, and break tasks into subtasks. Doneit Assist can now also create a brief summary of a task list, highlight its key tasks for you to focus on, as well as show the upcoming tasks in this list.

products.name: VoiceCap
products.tagline: The AI notetaker for meetings in your language
products.description: Most AI notetakers are strong in English and mediocre in everything else. VoiceCap transcribes in 100+ languages and writes the summary, action items and decisions in that same language. Record in the room via native apps, send a bot to Zoom, Meet or Teams, or upload a file. Every meeting becomes a searchable record of what was decided and who owns it. Ask Claude or ChatGPT about it over MCP. EU company, recordings stored in Frankfurt, never used to train models. 300 free minutes, no card.

products.name: Ruby UTCP
products.tagline: The scalable, secure alternative to MCP for tool calling
products.description: Ruby UTCP brings UTCP 1.1 to Ruby, giving apps and AI agents a standard way to discover and call tools over native protocols. It supports 12 transports, including HTTP, CLI, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and WebRTC, plus streaming, auth, OpenAPI discovery, and CodeMode for programmable multi-tool workflows. Open source and built for the Ruby ecosystem.

products.name: Basedash Models
products.tagline: Define it once. Query it like a table.
products.description: Basedash Models is a semantic workspace of reusable, governed SQL for core business concepts—customers, orders, active accounts—so everyone works from the same trusted definition. Each model has dedicated views for details, columns, measures, and segments, plus synonyms, row grain, relationships, and usage guidance the assistant reads when it answers. Reference a model in SQL like a table: select * from models.customers. Define it once. Query it like a table.

products.name: Mise
products.tagline: The meal planner that gets all your dishes ready at once
products.description: Recipes help you cook one dish. But meals have multiple dishes! Mise schedules every dish backwards from the minute you want to eat: one start time, one running order, a merged shopping list, a cooking mode. That way you get everything ready at the right time and can work from a simple prep list that includes ingredients, instructions, and reminders. Free with no login.

products.name: Punch
products.tagline: Save your group chat's important stuff
products.description: You’re on vacation with your friends and you need to know the AirBnB address, the door code, the rendezvous spot, etc. Instead of scrolling through 100+ messages, save all that info on Punch and share with your friends and family. Why we're different: Notes App: This can fill up quick and can look clunky after a while. You also can’t share individual pieces from a note. Also, incompatibility between OS. Drive/Dropbox/etc.: Has the storage/shareability aspect, but is more geared toward storage.

products.name: BiBimba
products.tagline: Clipboard history that can read your screenshots
products.description: Clipboard history and screenshots, searchable together. BiBimba reads the text inside screenshots, so you can find a receipt total or an error message later and paste just what you need. On-device AI translates, summarizes, rewrites. Stays on your Mac. $9.
